usability_notes: The boundary between CONFLICTING and UNRESOLVED is ambiguous when an explicitly unsupported legacy proposal contradicts an explicit source binding. For INV-C02 episode_bindings I used CONFLICTING to retain the two assertions and their unequal stated support; this does not authenticate the proposal or select it.

The identity question requests aliases, but INV-C02 supplies only one explicitly registered person. I used SUPPORTED for that limited identity proposition and expressly recorded that no additional alias links are supplied.
For NOT_IN_INSPECTED_OBJECTS the required empty line list means the form cannot cite a line explicitly declaring absence. Reasons therefore describe the casebook-only scope without line citations.

Grouped questions combine supported subclaims and missing material relations. I used UNRESOLVED where the overall requested join or interpretation remains missing and retained the supported subclaims in the assertion.
